## About this guide

Load lookup settings, resolve a form model and prepare shared reference snapshots.

## Load a form model

```{r}
# Load the selected ROS form model.
form_model_definition <- ros.form.model::ros_form(
  name = ros.form.model::ROS_FORM_LL,
  version = ros.form.model::ROS_FORM_VERSION_4_2_0)
```

## Load reference configuration

```{r}
# Read the bundled catalogue sources and lookup settings without downloading data.
reference_configuration <- ros.form.references::ros_lookup_configuration()
# Resolve the model bindings while keeping the original form model unchanged.
reference_resolved_form_model <- ros.form.references::resolve_ros_lookups(
  form_model_definition, reference_configuration)
# Inspect the configured catalogues.
names(reference_configuration$catalogues)
```

## Prepare snapshots

Copy the configuration and adjust the sources for your deployment.

For private catalogues, use the complete private example and set `ROS_REGISTRY_PASSWORD` in your environment.

These commands require access to the configured catalogues.

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Copy the private configuration example into the working directory for editing.
file.copy(
  system.file("references.private.example.yaml", package = "ros.form.references"),
  "references.yaml", overwrite = FALSE)
```

Edit the source URLs and user name in `references.yaml`, then set the password environment variable.

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Read the deployment configuration, including credentials from the environment.
reference_configuration <- ros.form.references::ros_lookup_configuration("references.yaml")
# Download and verify the tables selected by the form model.
reference_snapshot_directory <- ros.form.references::prepare_ros_reference_snapshots(
  "references",
  reference_configuration$catalogues$code_lists$source,
  reference_configuration$catalogues$registries$source,
  models = list(form_model_definition),
  configuration = reference_configuration)
```

## Use saved references

Loading a snapshot uses its local files and frozen lookup settings. It does not require catalogue credentials.

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Load and verify the saved references required by the form model.
reference_snapshots <- ros.form.references::read_ros_references(
  reference_snapshot_directory, list(form_model_definition))
# Select the prepared species-code lookup.
reference_species_lookup <- reference_snapshots[["code_lists/refs_biology.species/code"]]
# Match submitted codes, applying catalogue aliases automatically.
reference_species_rows <- form.references::reference_match_rows(
  reference_species_lookup, c("RMJ", "RMM", "UNKNOWN"))
# Inspect the number of matching rows for each submitted code.
lengths(reference_species_rows)
# Retrieve the canonical record matched by the first submitted code.
reference_species_lookup$data[reference_species_rows[[1]], , drop = FALSE]
# Inspect aliases belonging to this lookup.
reference_species_lookup$aliases
# Inspect the saved file paths and checksums for this lookup.
attr(reference_snapshots, "provenance")[["code_lists/refs_biology.species/code"]]
```

Unknown values return no rows; multiple matches remain available for the consumer to handle.

## Snapshot contents

Each snapshot is a directory containing local catalogues and their configuration:

| File                      | Contents                                             |
|---------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `references.yaml`         | Local source paths and frozen lookup settings.       |
| `catalogue.csv`           | Required table paths, versions and checksums.        |
| `catalogue.yaml`          | Catalogue timestamp and checksum.                    |
| Table CSV files           | Exact bytes of the selected source tables.           |
| `catalogue_aliases.csv`   | Aliases for selected lookups, when any are needed.   |

Each catalogue has its own subdirectory. Credentials are excluded from the snapshot.

Snapshots can be moved and reused independently of their original sources.

Missing files, invalid checksums or conflicting lookup settings raise an error.
